summary: Hiker injured a knee about 1.5 miles up Cathedral Lake Trail; text-to-911 at 2:04 p.m.; 17 Mountain Rescue Aspen members in 3 teams reached the hiker 3:39 p.m. and carried them down; hiker self-transported to Aspen Valley Hospital, declining further medical assistance; all out by 4:32 p.m.
location: Cathedral Lake Trail, ~1.5 miles up, near Aspen
notes: The Next Summit article published 2024-07-11, retelling the Pitkin County Sheriff's Office / Mountain Rescue Aspen release; July 8, 2024 was a Monday (Monday-verified). Run 1019 chunk B.
